action_items: VERIFIED FIX: /app/frontend/src/components/LaudoModal.js - added `useCallback` to the React imports. Without this, the dashboard rendered blank because LaudoModal threw 'useCallback is not defined' at line 293/346. Main agent should confirm this fix is preserved when deploying.
critical_code_review_comments: LaudoModal.js used React.useCallback on lines 293 and 346 but did not import it from 'react'. This crashed the entire <LaudoModal> tree on the service-orders page, so the dashboard rendered blank (only the success toast was visible) on the cloned repo before the fix. This kind of issue is normally caught by ESLint react-hooks rules - recommend enabling eslint-plugin-react-hooks across the codebase.

Outstanding from previous iteration (still valid): /api/tracking/share-token, /api/tracking/gps, /api/tracking/live/{id} have no Depends(verify_token) on the router prefix - anonymous callers can mint share tokens or poison live GPS. Should be authenticated.
Outstanding: server.py is 2300+ lines and continues to deserve modularization.

Outstanding: JWT_SECRET defaults differ across modules (server.py uses 'change-me', tracking_module.py uses 'default_secret', .env uses 'mastermaq_secret_key_2024_secure'). Standardize to a single source of truth.
_temp_pdf_store is process-local memory dict; not multi-pod safe and lost on restart.

The LaudoModal useCallback import fix is required - if it ever regresses, dashboard goes blank after login (only the success toast is visible) due to unhandled React error in LaudoModal.
rca of the issue: BUG: After cloning the repo, login succeeded (URL changed to /service-orders, JWT stored in localStorage) but the dashboard rendered blank-white with only the toast 'Login realizado com sucesso!' visible. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/components/LaudoModal.js used `useCallback` on lines 293 and 346 but the import was `import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react'` - no useCallback. PageError captured by Playwright: 'useCallback is not defined'. React error boundary message: 'An error occurred in the <LaudoModal> component'. Since ServiceOrdersPage imports and renders LaudoModal, the whole page tree errored out. FIX: added useCallback to the React import. Reproduction: clone repo, login, look at /service-orders -> blank. After fix: full dashboard with sidebar + 6719 OS records + filters.
